definitions.explanation: The state of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, especially as it affects outdoor activities.

examples.japanese: {天候|てんこう}が{悪|わる}いので、{試合|しあい}は{中止|ちゅうし}だ。
examples.english: The game is canceled due to bad weather.

examples.japanese: {天候|てんこう}に{恵|めぐ}まれた。
examples.english: We were blessed with good weather.

examples.japanese: {天候|てんこう}{不順|ふじゅん}が{続|つづ}いている。
{天候|てんこう}の{変化|へんか}に{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please be careful of changes in the weather.

examples.japanese: {天候|てんこう}が{回復|かいふく}すれば{明日|あした}の{登山|とざん}は{予定|よてい}{通|どお}り{行|おこな}うが、{悪天候|あくてんこう}の{場合|ばあい}は{中止|ちゅうし}になる。
examples.english: If the weather recovers, tomorrow's climb will go ahead as planned, but it will be canceled in the event of bad weather.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
・{天候|てんこう}: Weather (formal, often used in news/official contexts)
・{天気|てんき}: Weather (general, everyday usage)
・{気候|きこう}: Climate (long-term weather patterns)

{天候|てんこう} is more formal than {天気|てんき} and is often used in official announcements and news reports.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{天候|てんこう}が{悪|わる}い/{良|よ}い (bad/good weather)
・{天候|てんこう}に{恵|めぐ}まれる (to be blessed with good weather)
・{天候|てんこう}{不順|ふじゅん} (unsettled/unstable weather)
・{天候|てんこう}の{回復|かいふく} (weather recovery)
